findings.title: Close button touch target below 44x44px minimum
findings.description: The close button (.drawer-close-button) has explicit dimensions of 2rem x 2rem (32x32px). WCAG 2.5.8 (Target Size Minimum) requires interactive elements to have a minimum target size of 24x24px (AA), but the healthcare mandate and WCAG 2.5.5 (Target Size Enhanced, AAA best practice for healthcare) recommends 44x44px.
findings.fix: Change width and height of .drawer-close-button from 2rem to 2.75rem (44px), or use min-width/min-height: 44px to ensure the touch target meets the 44x44px guideline.

findings.title: role="document" on panel is incorrect for a drawer
findings.description: The drawer panel element has role="document" (line 588). The 'document' role causes screen readers to exit forms/application mode and enter browse mode, which can interfere with keyboard interaction patterns.
findings.fix: Remove role="document" from the panel div. The panel is a structural child of the dialog and needs no explicit role.

findings.title: No-header mode removes close button, leaving no keyboard-accessible dismiss mechanism
findings.description: When no-header is set to true (line 506), the entire header including the close button is removed from the DOM. Keyboard-only users have no visible, discoverable way to close the drawer.
findings.fix: When noHeader is true, render a visually hidden but focusable close button so keyboard and screen reader users always have a discoverable close mechanism.

findings.title: Focus restoration occurs after animation delay, leaving focus in limbo
findings.description: In _closeDrawer() (line 327-334), focus restoration to the trigger element is deferred by the animation duration (300ms). During this window, focus remains on an element inside the drawer that is becoming invisible.
findings.fix: Move focus restoration to happen immediately when _closeDrawer() is called, before the animation timeout.

findings.title: Missing test for aria-labelledby pointing to correct title ID
findings.description: The test suite verifies that aria-labelledby is present but does not verify that the value matches the actual ID of the title element.
findings.fix: Add an assertion that verifies the aria-labelledby value equals the id attribute of the title element.
